svg.title: GO B.C. FERRIES — reconstructed vector sticker
svg.desc: Editable geometric reconstruction of the supplied 1354 × 1161 raster reference. Manually authored illustration paths and shape primitives; outlined reconstructed lettering. Flat colours replace photographic colour variation. Original source coordinates are preserved without post-hoc registration.

g.inkscape:label: 01 · Border and teal field
g.title: Reconstructed smooth eight-arc sticker perimeter and inner field

g.inkscape:label: 02 · Mountains and snow
g.title: Manually constructed mountain ridge with three snow caps

g.inkscape:label: 03 · Ferry
g.title: Hand-built coastal ferry illustration
g.desc: Reconstructed with cubic curves, polygons, rectangular windows, and circular portholes on the original 1354 by 1161 reference coordinate grid. Gull is a separate overlaid group. Hidden geometry behind the gull is continued coherently.

g.inkscape:label: 04 · Gull
g.title: Hand-drawn soaring gull, with separate feather tips and eye
